phase_name: Phase 15-7/15-8 Measurement Results Consistency and Cross-Validation Template
phase_japanese_name: Phase 15-7/15-8 実測結果の突合・整合確認テンプレート
purpose: Design the cross-validation and consistency confirmation template for Phase 15-7 and 15-8 measurement results, providing a structured procedure to verify both measurement records are complete, consistent with each other, and establish the final dual-gate unlock decision (integrated_decision=GO AND receiver_validator_permission=EFFECTIVE) required for app/tests implementation authorization

template_usage_notes.when_to_use: Fill this template after both Phase 15-7 and Phase 15-8 measurement records are complete (Phase 19-1 and 19-2 templates filled)
template_usage_notes.template_status: DESIGN_TEMPLATE (not yet filled; Phase 15-7 and 15-8 not yet executed)
template_usage_notes.filling_authority: Authority who signed Phase 18-8 launch authorization (or explicitly delegated role)
template_usage_notes.note: This template bridges measurement records (Phase 19-1/19-2) to implementation unlock decisions (Phase 20+)

section_1_input_records_receipt.description: Receive and confirm Phase 19-1 and 19-2 measurement execution records are complete and present

section_2_individual_result_verification.description: Verify each measurement record's internal consistency (evidence hash, authority signature, execution step completeness)

step_1_evidence_hash_recompute.action: Recompute SHA-256+ hash of Phase 19-1 execution steps and result, compare against stored hash

step_2_authority_signature_verify.action: Verify Phase 19-1 result authority signature (algorithm, signer identity, revocation status, expiry)

step_3_execution_steps_completeness.action: Confirm all 7 Phase 15-7 execution steps are recorded with non-null results

step_4_go_criteria_consistency.action: Verify Phase 19-1 GO/NO_GO determination is consistent with all criteria evaluations

step_1_evidence_hash_recompute.action: Recompute SHA-256+ hash of Phase 19-2 execution steps and result, compare against stored hash

step_3_execution_steps_completeness.action: Confirm all 7 Phase 15-8 execution steps are recorded with non-null results

step_4_effective_criteria_consistency.action: Verify Phase 19-2 EFFECTIVE/NOT_EFFECTIVE determination is consistent with all criteria evaluations

section_3_cross_validation_consistency_c.description: Cross-validate Phase 15-7 and 15-8 results for mutual consistency

check_1_timestamp_ordering.description: Verify timestamp ordering is logical (sequential: 15-7 before 15-8; parallel: both within authorization window)

check_2_authority_consistency.description: Verify both measurements were performed under same or explicitly delegated authorities

check_3_authorization_reference_consiste.description: Verify both measurements reference a valid Phase 18-8 authorization signature

check_4_pre_execution_state_snapshot_con.description: Verify pre-execution state snapshots are consistent across both records

sequential_state_transition_valid.description: In sequential mode: Phase 15-8 pre-snapshot integrated_decision must reflect Phase 15-7 result

check_5_post_state_transition_consistenc.description: Verify post-measurement state transitions are logically consistent with determined results

section_4_dual_gate_unlock_determination.description: Determine whether the dual-gate condition (integrated_decision=GO AND receiver_validator_permission=EFFECTIVE) is met, enabling app/tests implementation unlock

scenario_1_both_gates_pass.condition: gate_1=GO AND gate_2=EFFECTIVE AND both_records_verified AND all_cross_checks_consistent
scenario_1_both_gates_pass.next_step: Proceed to Phase 20+ for app/tests implementation unlock. Final authority approval required.
scenario_1_both_gates_pass.note: This is the ONLY scenario where app/tests implementation may proceed

scenario_2_only_integrated_decision_go.next_step: Phase 15-8 must re-execute or remediation applied. Cannot unlock app/tests without both gates.
scenario_2_only_integrated_decision_go.note: integrated_decision=GO does NOT alone unlock app/tests

scenario_3_only_receiver_validator_effec.next_step: Phase 15-7 must re-execute or remediation applied. Cannot unlock app/tests without both gates.
scenario_3_only_receiver_validator_effec.note: receiver_validator_permission=EFFECTIVE does NOT alone unlock app/tests

scenario_4_both_gates_fail.next_step: Both Phase 15-7 and 15-8 must re-execute after remediation. Escalate to Phase 18-5 HOLD/HALT procedures.

scenario_5_integrity_failure.condition: ANY record integrity check fails OR any cross-check inconsistent
scenario_5_integrity_failure.next_step: Security investigation required. Do not use records with integrity failures. Re-execute affected measurements.

section_5_cross_validation_evidence_lock.description: Lock the cross-validation result as tamper-proof evidence

cross_validation_evidence_hash_sha256_pl.description: SHA-256+ hash of sections 1-4 of this document

section_6_post_cross_validation_actions.description: Required actions after Phase 19-3 cross-validation completes

actions.action: Store this cross-validation record in immutable audit trail
Notify authority of dual-gate determination result via secure channel
If DUAL_GATE_UNLOCKED: Prepare Phase 20+ implementation unlock authorization request for authority review
If PARTIAL_UNLOCK_ONLY or DUAL_GATE_NOT_UNLOCKED: Route to Phase 18-5 remediation for failing gate(s)
If CONSISTENCY_VERIFICATION_FAILED: Activate security investigation. Do NOT proceed to Phase 20+.

phase_19_3_completion_criteria: Input records receipt template (2 records: Phase 19-1 and 19-2) designed
Individual record verification procedure (4 steps per record) designed
Dual-gate unlock determination with 5-scenario decision matrix designed
Dual-gate condition explicitly stated: ONLY both gates pass = app/tests GO
No changes to app/ or tests/ directories
